headline: Recovery is improving; prioritize sleep today
summary: Sunday’s rest helped: Body Battery rose to 83 and readiness to 37. But sleep was only 5h 22m, following two short nights. Rest from running and cycling today; optional gentle walking only.

recommendation.title: Rest from running and cycling today
details: Optional: 20–30 minutes relaxed walking at RPE 1–2 and gentle mobility.
No tempo, intervals, long run or make-up mileage. Prioritize a longer night before reassessing tomorrow.
recommendation.alternative: Complete rest if tired, sore or unwell; walking is optional.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop for pain that changes gait, illness, unusual fatigue or dizziness. Seek urgent care for chest pain, fainting or severe breathlessness.

signals.label: Repeated short sleep
signals.interpretation: Accumulating short nights remains the main reason not to add training.

signals.label: Recovery improving
signals.interpretation: Rest is helping, but these gains do not require immediately adding mileage.

signals.label: Recent long-run cost
signals.interpretation: Another low-load day allows recovery without stacking further endurance work.

caveats: Device measurements and classifications are Garmin data; the recommendation is coaching judgment.
Garmin’s recovery timer concerns another hard effort, not all movement.
Pain, illness, unusual sleepiness, dizziness and medical advice override device scores.
